entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 03/ 06-02-2013 Heard learned counsels for the petitioner and the State.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 409, 272 of the Indian Penal Code and 51/59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act.

Petitioner was posted as Assistant Godown Manager of S.F.C., Chautham when the S.D.O. took the sample of the wheat from the godown, which was not found confirming to the prescribed standard of the quality.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is not responsible for maintaining the standard of the grains as the grains were supplied by the F.C.I. and this is not in dispute that the seized grains were not supplied by the F.C.I.

Considering the aforesaid facts, let the above named petitioner be released on anticipatory bail in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned court below within a period of twelve weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned CJM, Khagaria in connection with Chautham P.S. Case No. 35 of 2012, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Dinesh Kumar Singh, J.) DKS/
